description: Vamdrup Church stands at the west end of the town in a green churchyard: a granite-ashlar nave and a west tower under a saddle roof with blind-arched gables, with low houses beyond the trees. The yard is empty. It is clear, about 6.7°C. The wind is light, about 6.1 km/h. Low morning sun, long shadows. This is not the yellow-brick square at Christiansfeld.
